comments.author: @surf7642
comments.text: I looked at this form and the relevant CFR provision regarding "license or other ownership" interest.  I will have to pay the higher small entity fee because of the license language.  glad I caught this as fixing the problem later could be annoying.  I suppose someone could file micro entity first and then sign a license agreement at least a day later.  of course, it's better just to pay the extra amount rather than have any hassle later.
